scope: Alpha-next PLAN section 2, producer-side log fix: ReceiptWriter, emit sites, receipt_lines grader, CPU witness and mutants; hub CPU tests only; no box or GPU evidence

leaves.name: alpha-next-receipts-vllm-add-prefix
leaves.replaces: vLLM vllm/utils/system_utils._add_prefix, which decorate_logs installs on sys.stdout/sys.stderr (multiproc_executor.py:1067, 1095; v1/engine/core.py:1303)
leaves.equivalence: Declared equivalent: the pinned source is not under reference/vllm-src. Copied from a hub tree (tmp scratchpad of another session, .../scratchpad/le/vllm-src/vllm) whose 491 files that overlap reference/vllm-src are byte-identical to it (6 differ, all files this project patches: qsa.py x2, block_pool.py, single_type_kv_cache_manager.py, scheduler.py, gpu/model_runner.py). Source file sha256 837e6ff0ab524c06c048d6b42d4f35b77baba2e9d9e57837fe333ca0aaee1cfb, lines 201-234 sha256 88f5c10153e9343be6c34a62c4431a298ba6b16b1721e86f24e66ff123fdba64. One change: the colour branch is fixed to the non-tty prefix '(<name> pid=<pid>) ' because vllm.envs is not importable here; the box's lines carry no colour codes, so that is the box's branch.
leaves.cannot_prove: that the image's system_utils.py is this file (it was not extracted from the image and pinned by sha, as PLAN 2 asks); the old path's exact syscall split on the box

leaves.name: alpha-next-receipts-old-path-stream
leaves.replaces: vLLM's worker logger path: init_logger's StreamHandler on the decorated default sys.stdout
leaves.equivalence: The witness child uses the real default object open(1, 'w') (TextIOWrapper over a BufferedWriter sized by the pipe's st_blksize) with a logging.StreamHandler and a vLLM-shaped format; StreamHandler.emit writes msg + newline then flushes, as on the box. The structural test uses a counting RawIOBase under a BufferedWriter of the same size in place of the FileIO.
leaves.cannot_prove: vLLM's exact formatter text; the docker/containerd side of the pipe

leaves.name: alpha-next-receipts-shared-pipe
leaves.replaces: the container stdout FIFO that every worker process and the engine share (docker non-tty stdio, a containerd FIFO)
leaves.equivalence: one os.pipe whose write end is each child's fd 1 (dup2); the writer makes its own private dup(1) and checks S_ISFIFO and select.PIPE_BUF exactly as in production; POSIX atomicity of writes <= PIPE_BUF holds for both
leaves.cannot_prove: that the box's stdout is a FIFO (the first box run's receipt_path line shows it)

leaves.name: alpha-next-receipts-capture-write
leaves.replaces: os.write in ReceiptWriter (its write= seam) and, for getpid=, os.getpid
leaves.equivalence: the leaf records (fd, bytes) of every call and returns the byte count, or scripts one short write / one OSError; the writer is otherwise the real class on a real pipe fd (so the path check is real)

leaves.name: alpha-next-receipts-emit-site-fakes
leaves.replaces: the objects around each real emit function: SimpleNamespace QsaPrefillOperation/NativeWorkerBridge/StagedSegmentDriver selves (as test_alpha_m3_receipts), FakeCuda (test_alpha_m3_receipts), TimingEvent/FakeClock (test_e3_native_anatomy), a torch module stub for s5_startup._device_spans, and the stage-1 Rig of test_stage1_handler_anatomy (its declared leaves)
leaves.equivalence: each emit function runs unchanged; the fakes supply only the attributes it reads
leaves.cannot_prove: that the startup seams run in every box process (checked structurally on s5_startup's AST; the box run's per-process receipts records show it)

leaves.name: alpha-next-receipts-mutant-engine-dir
leaves.replaces: patches/s5_engine/native_measurement.py by a mutated copy first on sys.path (ALPHA_NEXT_RECEIPTS_ENGINE, harness only)
leaves.equivalence: each mutant is one exact text replacement of the committed source, refused unless it matches exactly once; the run prints the module file it imported
